name: qh-swelite-requests-identity-01
command: python -B -c 'import subprocess,json; base="091991be0da19de9108dbe5e3752917fea3d7fdc"; tree=lambda rev: {v.split(b"\t",1)[1]:v.split(b"\t",1)[0].split() for v in subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-tree","-rz",rev]).split(b"\0") if v}; a,b=tree(base),tree("HEAD"); print(json.dumps({"base_entries":len(a),"image_entries":len(b),"same_paths":a.keys()==b.keys(),"changed_blobs":sum(a[k][1:]!=b[k][1:] for k in a.keys()&b.keys()),"changed_modes":sum(a[k][0]!=b[k][0] for k in a.keys()&b.keys())})); assert a.keys()==b.keys() and all(a[k][1:]==b[k][1:] for k in a)'
